mechanism.who_is_forced_or_underreacts: The FORCED participant is the correcting filer: a Form 4/A that CHANGES the reported transaction must re-state the record - the correction is compelled, and its signed content (more disposition than originally printed, or less) is a fact the filer cannot soften. An UPWARD correction (amendment discloses MORE insider disposition than the original) reveals that the original UNDERSTATED completed insider supply: adverse information that stood uncorrected in the public record until the amendment landed. The LATE/wrong participant is the attention-limited outside reader who prices the 4/A as a clerical footnote: without the (issuerCik, rptOwnerCik, periodOfReport) pair reconstruction - which no standard data product carries and which the pinned substrate could not express until this cycle - the correction print arrives without its original, and the market under-reacts to what the correction's DIRECTION AND SIZE reveal about the true flow.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: The correction-severity literature (restatements as the severe tail of the same class) documents that market reactions scale with what the correction changes - downward corrections of core figures react hardest (Palmrose-Richardson-Scholz 2004; Files-Swanson-Tse 2009 for focal points). The insider-filing correction class has never been priced as a cross-section: if headline readers lump all 4/A prints together as noise, issuers whose amendments INCREASE reported insider disposition are under-priced-worse and issuers whose amendments REDUCE it are under-priced-better at the amendment print, and the 21-session window drifts accordingly.

(b) vs the V13 insider twins (0.232/0.2402 vs vol_level): no cross-sectional ranking of REALIZED flow direction and no inferred process class - the ranked quantity is the CORRECTION delta between two documents, defined only where a resolvable pair exists. (c) vs the ng1 10b5-1 kills (goodwill_bloat -0.3547/-0.384): no declared-plan flag, no flagged-session cadence, no plan-share composition; the plan-share FORM (a same-stream ratio) died on plan-share CONTENT - P2's anchor is a DIFFERENT content (correction delta) in an ADV-normalized signed-days form, and the ng1_10b5_1_* vetoes are measured.
